transcript: Speaker A: This is a bus stop. I am waiting for the bus. Waiting means I stay here. I am not moving. I am waiting. I am getting on the bus. Getting on means entering. I go inside the bus. I am finding a seat. Finding means looking for something. I look for a place to sit. I am holding the handle. Holding means keeping something in my hand. I hold the handle to stay safe. I am getting off the bus. Getting off means leaving. I come out of the bus. I am crossing the road. Crossing means going from one side to the other. I walk carefully.
